product.title: O crima anuntata
product.description: Când gazeta locală anunță că va avea loc o crimă la Little Paddocks, vineri, 29 octombrie, la ora 18.30, tot satul, crezând că este vorba de un joc, se prezintă la întâlnire. Dar, brusc, toate luminile se sting, se aud împușcături, apoi este descoperit un tânăr necunoscut, ucis. Iar acesta este doar începutul. Alte crime urmează, și numai Miss Marple va fi în stare să soluționeze cea mai ingenioasă crimă.

## Unraveling Mystery with "O Crima Anuntata"

Are you ready for a classic whodunit? *O crima anuntata* is a captivating piece of literary fiction that plunges readers into the heart of village mystery, guided by the brilliant deductive skills of Miss Marple. This novel follows a tense sequence of events at Little Paddocks when the local newspaper announces that a crime will take place on Friday, October 29th, at 6:30 PM.

What begins as what everyone assumes is merely a game quickly descends into terror. When the lights suddenly go out and the sounds of gunfire echo through the house, an unknown young man is discovered dead. This shocking incident is just the beginning. As more crimes follow, only Miss Marple possesses the keen insight necessary to solve this ingenious mystery.

### Dive Into a World of Intrigue and Deduction

This gripping tale of crime keeps you guessing until the very last page. Litera brings you this highly engaging collection of fiction, perfect for fans of classic detective stories and atmospheric mysteries. Join Miss Marple as she navigates whispered secrets, suspicious characters, and deadly coincidences in the quaint yet sinister setting of Little Paddocks.

Whether you are a seasoned mystery reader or new to Agatha Christie's world, *O crima anuntata* promises hours of thrilling reading. Discover why this book remains a cornerstone of classic crime fiction literature.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book suitable for new readers of Miss Marple?**
A: While the novel is highly engaging, it captures the classic tone and style associated with Agatha Christie's best mysteries, making it an excellent entry point for newcomers.

**Q: What kind of setting does the story take place in?**
A: The initial action centers around Little Paddocks, suggesting a mix of intimate village life juxtaposed against sudden, shocking crime.
